      "rationale": "The daily briefing lacked valve-by-valve content (supported), and there is no evidence the crew received a recent change briefing or saw the specific configuration drawing used (unknown). The gap is the actual observation of valve states and configuration at time of work."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-u3hp7x",

    "summary": "The investigation identifies information gaps (lack of recent change briefing, incomplete point register data) as contributing factors that may have delayed recognition of the air interruption. However, these are not sufficient causes on their own; a physical failure or upstream disturbance must also be present. The evidence does not confirm whether valves were open contrary to procedure or if an unrecorded service-routing change occurred.",

    ],

      "Point of interruption (source, distribution, receiving)",
      "External factors affecting supply"
    ],
    "alternatives": [

      "Valve open contrary to procedure"
